description: Season-aware conference-membership windows per programme (institution_slug x gender), 2016-2026. Authored from official GAC/MIAA, LSC, GSC, GLVC, RMAC, SSC, NE10, CACC and ECC records; each window cites its source. Sibling in role to the generated canon.json identity map - identity and membership are separate axes (tl-ath plan gate, 2026-08-08).

Auburn Montgomery Warhawks, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Auburn_Montgomery_Warhawks (accessed 2026-08-20): AUM was approved for the NCAA Division II membership process on 2015-07-17 and "began the transition with the 2015-16 season, while joining the Gulf South Conference for all sports effective in the 2017-18 season." The window therefore opens at 2017. This corrects an earlier reading of the conference statistics pages (https://gscsports.org/stats.aspx?path=msoc&year=2018&conf=true), which appeared to show AUM first joining in 2019: those pages omit schools still inside the D2 provisional period, which compete on a full conference schedule without counting toward conference statistics. Nine distinct GSC member sites independently published AUM as a conference opponent in each of 2017 and 2018 — a full round-robin slate in both seasons.
